say:1:1322137001:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Valka has found a suitable location, and the two acolytes are ready for the purification.
say:1:1322137001:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Valka has found a suitable location, and the two acolytes are ready for the purification.
say:1:1322137001:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, Valka has found a suitable location, and the two acolytes are ready for the purification.

say:2:1322137002:1.text: If you are ready, let's go.
say:2:1322137002:1.source_cn: 如果你们也准备好了，我们就出发吧。

choice_prompt:3:1322137002.text: If you are ready, let's go.
choice_prompt:3:1322137002.source_cn: 如果你们也准备好了，我们就出发吧。

say:4:1322137003:1.text: Let's <style="highlight">go to St. Kinga's Temple</style> first. The acolytes are waiting for us there.

say:1:1322138001:1.text: Praise the goddess, you're here! I hope Brother Maxim and I are fully prepared this time.
say:1:1322138001:1.source_cn: 赞美女神，你们来了！希望这次我和马克西姆兄弟准备得足够充分。

say:2:1322138002:1.text: To be honest, I'm a bit scared, and my heart's racing... but I had no reason to complain. This is my duty, and it was the right path guided by the goddess.
say:2:1322138002:1.source_cn: 说实话，我有些害怕，心跳得很快……但我没什么可抱怨的，...

say:3:1322138003:1.text: Dura will bless us on this journey.

say:4:1322138004:1.text: I have no doubt about this. Lady Carolina, please lead the way.
say:4:1322138004:1.source_cn: 我对此坚信不疑。卡列琳娜女士，请您带路吧。

say:1:1322140001:1.text: This is the final battle! A struggle to guide your souls to peace!
say:1:1322140001:1.source_cn: 这是最后一场战斗！一场通往和平与宁静的灵魂之战！

say:6:1322140004:1.text: Warriors, the Frost Furie lies sealed. Victory is ours!
say:6:1322140004:1.source_cn: 战士们，冰之恶魔已经被封印，那场战争，我们——赢了！

say:8:1322140006:1.text: Today, we shall fight together one final time. This time, our foe is the malice and madness that dwells within each of us, unrestrained and untamed.
say:8:1322140006:1.source_cn: 今天，我们将最后一次并肩作战。这次我们的敌人是大家难以...

say:9:1322140007:1.text: This is the final battle! A struggle to guide your souls to peace!
say:9:1322140007:1.source_cn: 这是最后一场战斗！一场通往和平与宁静的灵魂之战！

say:10:1322140008:1.text: Claim victory! We shall meet again in a future bright and warm!
say:10:1322140008:1.source_cn: 赢下它！我们将会在充满光明和温暖的未来重逢！

say:11:1322140009:1.text: It's been an honor... to serve you...
say:11:1322140009:1.source_cn: 很荣幸……能在您麾下作战……

say:15:1322140011:1.text: Oh, goddess, we pray to you at this solemn hour…Though sorrow lingers in the night, peace comes with the morrow…
say:15:1322140011:1.source_cn: 女神啊，在这庄严的时刻，我们向您祷告……尽管悲伤在夜晚...

say:16:1322140012:1.text: Grant us the grace that death is not the end... Let them enter your kingdom, where every tear is wiped away...
say:16:1322140012:1.source_cn: 女神啊，赐予我们恩典，死亡不再是终结……让他们去往您的...

say:18:1322140013:1.text: Guided by the call for their souls and Carolina's soothing voice, the undead slowly awaken to themselves. They fight to quell madness within their hearts.
say:18:1322140013:1.source_cn: 伴随着灵魂的召唤和卡列琳娜温柔的声音，活死人们渐渐找回...

say:20:1322140014:1.text: Acolytes Ogden and Maxim, begin the purification!
say:20:1322140014:1.source_cn: 奥格列修士、马克西姆修士，开始净化吧！

say:23:1322140016:1.text: The acolytes begin the purification. Some of the undead gradually fade away under the Divine Light, but there are too many, and the acolytes find themselves struggling.
say:23:1322140016:1.source_cn: 两位修士开始了净化。一些活死人在圣光的照耀之下，微笑着...

say:1:1322141001:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，我……我已经耗尽所有力气了……

say:2:1322141002:1.text: Hold on... this is the last one.
say:2:1322141002:1.source_cn: 要坚持住……这是最后一个！

narration:4:1322141003:1.text: Bathed in the Divine Light, the last undead warrior stands tall, saluting Valka with unwavering respect. His figure shimmers and fades, his spirit finally at peace as he vanishes into the luminous embrace.

say:6:1322141004:1.text: *Sigh*... Did it really work? Were all the undead purified?
say:6:1322141004:1.source_cn: 呼……呼……成功了吗？那些活死人……那些战士们，真的被...

say:7:1322141005:1.text: They won't rise again, will they?
say:7:1322141005:1.source_cn: 他们……他们不会再一次又一次复生为没有理智的活死人了，是吗？

say:8:1322141006:1.source_cn: 是的。他们永远地离开了。

say:10:1322141007:1.text: Don't be sad, Valka. They've found their way to the kingdom of the goddess, where there's no pain or parting, only eternal light.
say:10:1322141007:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡姐姐，别难过。他们去了女神的神国，那里没有痛苦和...

say:11:1322141008:1.text: Yes... they may at last find peace. I am glad, truly glad.
say:11:1322141008:1.source_cn: 是啊……他们终于可以获得安宁了。我很高兴，真的很高兴。

say:12:1322141009:1.text: Dura above, it's a miracle! On behalf of everyone in the temple, I thank you and offer my blessings!
say:12:1322141009:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这是个奇迹！伟大的奇迹！我……我代表修道院所...

say:13:1322141010:1.text: No, I should be the one to thank you two for coming to our aid. May the goddess bless you both.
say:13:1322141010:1.source_cn: 不，应该是我谢谢你们两位。愿女神赐福于你们。

say:15:1322141011:1.text: Brother Maxim, let's return. We need to report this good news to the temple as soon as possible. Friends, please allow us to leave our leave.
say:15:1322141011:1.source_cn: 马克西姆兄弟，我们快回去……我们得立刻把这个好消息报告...

say:18:1322141012:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we also want to express our gratitude for your help. If it weren't for you, it might have taken us much longer to accomplish what we did here today.
say:18:1322141012:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we also want to express our gratitude for your help. If it weren't for you, it might have taken us much longer to accomplish what we did here today.
say:18:1322141012:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, we also want to express our gratitude for your help. If it weren't for you, it might have taken us much longer to accomplish what we did here today.

say:19:1322141013:1.text: A hundred words of gratitude cannot suffice to convey the depths of our hearts, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I vow that the Graveborn of Whiteridge shall forever stand as your steadfast allies.
say:19:1322141013:1.source_cn: 一百次感谢的言辞都不足以表达我们内心的感受。<styl...
say:19:1322141013:1.male: A hundred words of gratitude cannot suffice to convey the depths of our hearts, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I vow that the Graveborn of Whiteridge shall forever stand as your steadfast allies.
say:19:1322141013:1.female: A hundred words of gratitude cannot suffice to convey the depths of our hearts, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>. I vow that the Graveborn of Whiteridge shall forever stand as your steadfast allies.

say:21:1322141014:1.text: Valka and Carolina thank you again. With a final exchange of goodbyes, you leave the land behind, its past of grief and despair fading into the mists of memory.
say:21:1322141014:1.source_cn: 瓦丽卡和卡列琳娜再次向你致谢。大家互相道别，离开了这片...

say:0:1322142001:0.text: Where are we going next, Magister?
say:0:1322142001:0.source_cn: 主人，我们接下来去哪里？
say:0:1322142001:0.male: Where are we going next, Magister?
say:0:1322142001:0.female: Where are we going next, Magister?

say:1:1322142002:0.text: How about we relax at the hot springs?
say:1:1322142002:0.source_cn: 忙了这么久，就去泡个温泉，放松一下吧。
say:1:1322142002:0.male: How about we relax at the hot springs?
say:1:1322142002:0.female: How about we relax at the hot springs?

say:1:1322146001:1.text: Hello, sir. Has a templar knight come to Cedartown recently?
say:1:1322146001:1.source_cn: 这位先生，请问最近是有圣骑士前来雪松镇吗？

say:2:1322146002:1.text: Yes! Yesterday, a lady named Temesia came galloping in on her stunning horse. She looked absolutely incredible.
say:2:1322146002:1.source_cn: 啊，是的是的！昨天来的，是位叫……呃，对了，名叫特弥希...

say:3:1322146003:1.text: Oh, it's Temesia! She must've come to assist the acolytes at Whiteridge Temple.
say:3:1322146003:1.source_cn: 竟然是特弥希娅！她一定是来协助白山修道院的圣职者们处理...

say:4:1322146004:1.text: I'm not sure what's going on, but the templar knight claimed the undead in Whiteridge aren't Hypogean followers—they're the warriors who battled the Hypogean long ago...
say:4:1322146004:1.source_cn: 也不知道怎么回事，圣骑士大人说咱们白山的那些活死人不是...

say:5:1322146005:1.text: Dura above, I can't tell what's true or false anymore. This has me so confused...
say:5:1322146005:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这到底是真的还是假的？！真是把我给弄糊涂了……

say:6:1322146006:1.text: Forget it. I'm done thinking about it. Anyway, I don't think the templar knight would lie to us.
say:6:1322146006:1.source_cn: 唉，算了，不想了，反正圣骑士大人是不会欺骗我们的。

say:1:1322147001:1.text: To say the hero of Whiteridge is a Graveborn is as absurd as claiming the moon is made of cheese.
say:1:1322147001:1.source_cn: 圣骑士大人说咱们白山的英雄是个亡灵……艾雅在上，这简直...

say:2:1322147002:1.text: Oh, it's you. I saw you at the ball... Do you really think Graveborn could be good? Could one become a hero?
say:2:1322147002:1.source_cn: 你们几个……哎，我在舞会上见过你们。你们说，亡灵真的能...

choice_prompt:3:1322147002.text: Oh, it's you. I saw you at the ball... Do you really think Graveborn could be good? Could one become a hero?
choice_prompt:3:1322147002.source_cn: 你们几个……哎，我在舞会上见过你们。你们说，亡灵真的能当英雄吗？

say:4:1322147004:1.source_cn: 哎，你这么一说，我倒是想起来一件事。

say:5:1322147005:1.text: My youngest son told me a year ago that a strange man with a sword in his back and a helmet covering his face saved him and helped drive away a pack of wolves that had surrounded him.
say:5:1322147005:1.source_cn: 我家小儿子一年前说，有个背上插着剑、戴着头盔看不见脸的...

say:6:1322147006:1.text: I even yelled at him for talking nonsense. How could someone be alive with a sword stuck in their back? But... could that have been true?
say:6:1322147006:1.source_cn: 我还斥责过他胡说，哪有人能身上插着一把剑还活着啊！难道...

say:7:1322147007:1.text: It sounds like your son met Igor. He's strange, but he's a friendly Graveborn.
say:7:1322147007:1.source_cn: 听起来你的小儿子遇到了伊戈尔，他虽然有些奇怪，但确实是...

say:8:1322147008:1.text: What? The undead have names? Dura above... I need time to think about all of this and talk to my son.
say:8:1322147008:1.source_cn: 啊？亡灵还有名字呢？！我的女神啊……不行不行，我得好好...

say:10:1322147003:1.text: Umm... I'm too scared to do that.

choice:3:1:2.text: Talk to one and judge for yourself.
choice:3:1:2.source_cn: 你可以去拜访亡灵，自己判断
choice:3:1:2.male: Talk to one and judge for yourself.
choice:3:1:2.female: Talk to one and judge for yourself.

say:1:1322148001:1.text: Hey, mister! Let me tell you a secret. When I was in the Ghostly Getaway, I saw a Graveborn!
say:1:1322148001:1.male: Hey, mister! Let me tell you a secret. When I was in the Ghostly Getaway, I saw a Graveborn!
say:1:1322148001:1.female: Hey, lady! Let me tell you a secret. When I was in the Ghostly Getaway, I saw a Graveborn!

say:3:1322148003:1.text: I don't know his name, but he was funny—always hopping around on the gravestones and wanting to play with me.
say:3:1322148003:1.source_cn: 我不知道他叫什么，但他很有趣，总是在墓碑上跳来跳去的，...

say:4:1322148004:1.text: Igor isn't a bad person, but you were really brave to play with him...
say:4:1322148004:1.source_cn: 虽然知道伊戈尔不是坏人，但你还真胆大啊，居然敢在密室里...

say:5:1322148005:1.text: He's not scary at all! Besides, I'm the bravest kid in Cedartown!
say:5:1322148005:1.source_cn: 嘿嘿，当然啦，他一点都不可怕。而且，我是整个雪松镇最勇...

say:1:1322149001:1.text: It seems that everything has turned out very well.
say:1:1322149001:1.source_cn: 看来这件事有了个很不错的结果呢。

say:2:1322149002:1.text: Yes, Valka and the others can finally stop being misunderstood by the people here. While the townsfolk still need time to completely shift their thinking, it's still a positive change.
say:2:1322149002:1.source_cn: 是呀，瓦丽卡他们终于可以不用被人们误解了。虽然这里的人...

say:3:1322149003:1.text: Though the others don't realize it, Chippy and I know well what you've done, Merlin. I'm going to write all of this down in my notes.
say:3:1322149003:1.source_cn: 虽然别人不知道，但我和满满都很清楚你的贡献。梅林，我会...
say:3:1322149003:1.male: Though the others don't realize it, Chippy and I know well what you've done, Merlin. I'm going to write all of this down in my notes.
say:3:1322149003:1.female: Though the others don't realize it, Chippy and I know well what you've done, Merlin. I'm going to write all of this down in my notes.

choice_prompt:4:1322149003.text: Though the others don't realize it, Chippy and I know well what you've done, Merlin. I'm going to write all of this down in my notes.
choice_prompt:4:1322149003.source_cn: 虽然别人不知道，但我和满满都很清楚你的贡献。梅林，我会在我的笔记里记下这件事！
choice_prompt:4:1322149003.male: Though the others don't realize it, Chippy and I know well what you've done, Merlin. I'm going to write all of this down in my notes.
choice_prompt:4:1322149003.female: Though the others don't realize it, Chippy and I know well what you've done, Merlin. I'm going to write all of this down in my notes.

say:5:1322149004:1.text: And Chippy helped also! Write down Chippy's name in your notes too!
say:5:1322149004:1.source_cn: 还有我！漫漫，别忘了把我的名字写在主人的名字下面！
say:5:1322149004:1.male: And Chippy helped also! Write down Chippy's name in your notes too!
say:5:1322149004:1.female: And Chippy helped also! Write down Chippy's name in your notes too!

choice:4:1:2.text: You can tell others of my greatness.
choice:4:1:2.source_cn: 我不介意你帮我做宣传
choice:4:1:2.male: You can tell others of my greatness.
choice:4:1:2.female: You can tell others of my greatness.

say:1:1322139001:0.text: It appears you are all prepared.
say:1:1322139001:0.source_cn: 看来你们都做好了准备。

say:2:1322139002:0.text: Acolytes of the faith, take your place within and do not stray beyond our guard so that we may shield you both.
say:2:1322139002:0.source_cn: 修士先生们，请你们站在里面，不要越过我们，方便我们保护...

say:3:1322139003:1.text: As the Sword of Death awakens their souls and allows them a brief return to themselves, I ask you to harness the Divine Light's power to purify them.
say:3:1322139003:1.source_cn: 等死神之剑唤起他们的灵魂、让他们短暂找回自我的时候，请...

say:4:1322139004:1.text: Alright. Though I'm still trembling a bit, Brother Maxim and I have vowed to the goddess that we'll see this through and use the Divine Light to end these warriors' suffering.
say:4:1322139004:1.source_cn: 好的。虽然我还是有些颤抖……但我和马克西姆兄弟已经向女...

say:7:1322139005:1.text: Very well. Carolina, you have ever been a steadfast devotee of Dura. When the purification commences, I ask that you offer prayers for my comrades.
say:7:1322139005:1.source_cn: 很好。卡列琳娜，你一直都是虔诚的信徒，等到净化开始的时...

say:8:1322139006:1.text: Don't worry, Valka. I know what to do.
say:8:1322139006:1.source_cn: 放心吧，瓦丽卡姐姐。我明白该怎么做。

say:11:1322139008:1.text: I know you also possess the power to seal and purify. Should the strength of the two acolytes prove insufficient, I ask that you lend them your aid.
say:11:1322139008:1.source_cn: 我知道你也有着封印与净化的能力，如果两位修士的力量不足...
say:11:1322139008:1.male: I know you also possess the power to seal and purify. Should the strength of the two acolytes prove insufficient, I ask that you lend them your aid.
say:11:1322139008:1.female: I know you also possess the power to seal and purify. Should the strength of the two acolytes prove insufficient, I ask that you lend them your aid.

choice_prompt:12:1322139008.text: I know you also possess the power to seal and purify. Should the strength of the two acolytes prove insufficient, I ask that you lend them your aid.
choice_prompt:12:1322139008.source_cn: 我知道你也有着封印与净化的能力，如果两位修士的力量不足以完成所有的净化，请你帮助他们。
choice_prompt:12:1322139008.male: I know you also possess the power to seal and purify. Should the strength of the two acolytes prove insufficient, I ask that you lend them your aid.
choice_prompt:12:1322139008.female: I know you also possess the power to seal and purify. Should the strength of the two acolytes prove insufficient, I ask that you lend them your aid.

say:14:1322139009:0.text: Igor, let go and revel in the moment!
say:14:1322139009:0.source_cn: 伊戈尔，放开手脚，好好“玩耍”吧！

say:15:1322139010:1.text: Ha! Everyone come! Dance with me on the tombstones! Fun will be had for all!
say:15:1322139010:1.source_cn: 哈哈！大家都来陪我跳墓碑！太棒了！

say:17:1322139011:0.text: When I unleash the power of the Sword of Death, all the undead nearby shall be drawn hither. They may grow frenzied and restless, for they sense the breath of the living... Take heed, and guard yourselves well.
say:17:1322139011:0.source_cn: 等我放出死神之剑的力量，这附近的活死人都会涌来，他们可...

say:18:1322139012:1.text: Everyone gives a solemn nod, their expressions sharp and determined as they begin their preparations.
say:18:1322139012:1.source_cn: 众人严肃地点了点头，各自做好了准备。

narration:25:13050516:0.text: The purification ritual is ready. Just then, frenzied undead attack you without warning.
narration:25:13050516:0.source_cn: 净化仪式准备就绪，狂躁不安的活死人向你们袭来。

narration:0:1322143001:1.text: Several days later, you find yourselves back in Cedartown again...

cinematic_dialogue:3:1322144001:.text: I want to be the templar knight!

cinematic_dialogue:3:1322144002:.text: But the templar knight is a lady!
cinematic_dialogue:3:1322144002:.source_cn: 不行！那位圣骑士是女士！

cinematic_dialogue:3:1322144003:.text: So? I'll be the knight, and I'll save you!
